parameters.name: LaunchTemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the launch template. For more information, see [DescribeLaunchTemplates](~~73759~~).

You must specify `LaunchTemplateId` or `LaunchTemplateName` to specify a launch template.

parameters.name: LaunchTemplateName
parameters.description:
The name of the launch template.

You must specify `LaunchTemplateId` or `LaunchTemplateName` to specify a launch template.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the launch template. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs delete-launch-template --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --launch-template-id lt-bp1apo0bbbkuy0rj0000 --launch-template-name testLaunchTemplateName --region cn-hangzhou
